title: Nex-tpa
description: Smal /tpa and /sethome mod wich also sends welcome messages
body:
This is a simple mod wich adds the ability to use /tpa to request a teleport to the named person it will cancel if u move within 5 seconds after sending the /tpa command
It also has a /sethome function allowing to set a place u can always return to via the /home command
